fact: BUNEC partnered with Liber Technologies in October 2025 to build a fully digital civil registration system by 2029, integrated with the new biometric national ID, per Biometric Update.
source_slug: 2025-10-27 Cameroon's BUNEC partners with Liber Technologies for CRVS digitization

fact: BUNEC's director general says BUNEC is already deploying an inter-administrative platform to link the civil registration system and the national ID system.
Cameroon's 2025-2029 plan aims to connect civil registration centres with identification services and to achieve interoperability by 2029 (We Are Tech Africa, via Biometric Update).

Cameroon's 2025-2029 strategic plan provides for interconnecting the principal civil registration centres with identification services and for the systems to exchange data with the national civil status system by 2029.
